listing.name: Doom 3 (classic) (dhewm3)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Established Doom 3 source port with Windows and Linux release assets. Limits: Established Doom 3 classic source port; BFG unsupported and game patch1.3.1 required upstream. Upstream platforms: Official Windows binaries are x86/32-bit per README; Windows x86-64 source build documented. Linux releases and Linux/macOS source builds documented; selected non-Windows archive CPU unknown. Original data: Own original classic Doom3 base/*.pk4 files. Use the engine-required patched classic version. Doom3 BFG Edition files are unsupported. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
